command: vite build; CHANGEDESK_ALL_IN=1 vite build; node zlib.gzipSync per emitted JS/CSS file
notes: React and react-dom are peer dependencies in the accepted SDK build.
Developer-owned CSS is compiled as inline module text: launcher styling stays in the entry and panel styling stays in the lazy panel chunk, avoiding an unreferenced library CSS artifact.
The launcher chunk contains a dynamic import for InternalPanel; neither the panel JS nor InternalPanel.css is fetched while the widget stays closed.
ReactDOM remains a compatible peer for host integration but contributes zero bytes because this SDK never imports it directly.
The all-in build is reported separately and is not the distributed peer-externalized artifact.
Source maps and declarations are excluded from runtime bundle totals.
